record.dic_text:
04367 Maknadbay {mak-nad-bah'-ee}

源自 04100 和 05068, 加上插於其中的 質詞/語助詞; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Machnadebai 1; 1

瑪拿底拜 = "他使我樂意的降卑"
1) 巴尼的眾子之一, 因以斯拉的命令而和其外邦妻子離婚 (#拉 10:40|)

04367 Maknadbay {mak-nad-bah'-ee}

from 04100 and 05068 with a particle interposed;; n pr m

AV - Machnadebai 1; 1

Machnadebai = "he brought low my willing ones"
1) one of the sons of Bani who put away his foreign wife at Ezra's
   command
